svg.title: Field data collection at an urban waterfront
svg.desc: A waterfront sensing schematic and real photographs of a fixed camera and a cellular base station. Camera detections over a footprint give local density. Directional camera-line events give crossing counts. An illustrative pipeline maps phone signals to regional aggregates and estimated occupancy. The study receives the aggregate location-based service estimates. Records retain reference and availability times for use at the forecast origin.
